text: auth routes: unauthenticated 500s from payload type confusion on /login and /register

Done in fe527d5. isinstance guards in validate_email/validate_password plus a new validate_device_label. login() answers a malformed email with the same 401 invalid_credentials as a wrong one - a 422 would be a response a correctly-shaped guess never gets, which is itself a signal. Parametrised tests assert no field of /login or /register can produce a 5xx.
